text.description: Body text. Only used when `share-text` is absent.

share-title.description: Title passed to the share sheet. Read BEFORE `title`; falls back to `document.title`.

share-text.description: Body text passed to the share sheet. Read BEFORE `text`.

share-url.description: URL to share. Read BEFORE `url`; falls back to the current page address.

url.description: URL to share. Only used when `share-url` is absent.
